review.brief_reason: The original and proposed expressions are extremely long and nearly identical. A careful character-level diff reveals one structural difference: in the original, a sub-expression contains 'sin(sin(0.48354460318587/sin(x1)) - log(x1)/x1)' while the proposed has 'sin(sin(x1) - log(x1)/x1)'. This changes the argument of the inner sin from '0.48354460318587/sin(x1)' to 'x1', which is not a constant-folding or domain-only change and will produce different values on the common domain. The expressions are otherwise of the same complexity, but this value difference means the simplification is not equivalent.
review.counterexample: x0=1.0, x1=1.0 (the sub-expression sin(sin(0.48354460318587/sin(x1)) - log(x1)/x1) vs sin(sin(x1) - log(x1)/x1) differs)
